verdict.rationale: Loops provides LMX, a markup format, plus a Content API for writing email content in code. Programmatic edits stay in sync with the visual editor, and an agent can rebuild existing templates in LMX via the API. Transactional sends support dynamic data variables, and the founder says the editor is built on extended MJML. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a version-control or git-based workflow for LMX files, detailed variable-substitution syntax docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of templates-as-code use.
